title: Gas Safe Register UK Business Search

location.title: Town or postcode
location.description: One UK town or postcode. Plain London selects the London, Middlesex entry; enter London, County Londonderry for the other source entry. For other ambiguous towns, enter Town, County.

serviceType.title: Service type
serviceType.description: Choose the Gas Safe Register search category.

maxResults.title: Maximum unique businesses
maxResults.description: Maximum unique businesses to return, deduplicated by registration number. The Actor automatically reads enough listing pages (about 10 businesses per page) to reach this count, up to 250.

includeEngineers.title: Include engineers
includeEngineers.description: Collect public engineer names, displayed status and contact details. Adds $0.05 per business when engineer details are returned.

includeQualifications.title: Include qualifications
includeQualifications.description: Collect Natural Gas, LPG and Building Regulations qualification details. Requires Include engineers. Adds $0.05 per business when qualification details are returned.
